description.value:
A heavy machete for the heavy-handed. This orcish one-piece cleaver may not boast an exquisite design, but it's brutally effective, especially when facing a heavily-modded opponent. The Razor won't remove their chrome with surgical precision, but any hit will surely crush it to bits, leaving a shimmering, bloody puddle on the sidewalk.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: PQ Very Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapons • Range: Melee

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: If the user has BODY 9+, then whenever this weapon incurs a Critical Injury, it deals 5 additional Bonus Damage (10 Total).

Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
